title: Per-method environment layer manifest
description: The committed manifest of the per-method environment layer artifacts (plan node method-env-images). The manifest is generated by scripts/generate-method-env-images.py, never hand-edited; regeneration parity is enforced by scripts/check-method-env-images.sh. Consumers read the manifest as data: the runtime fetches oci_ref@digest, verifies layer_sha256 before mounting, and reports size_bytes before downloading. Design reference: docs/method-env-layer-artifacts.md.

schema_version.description: The manifest shape version. Bump on any breaking field change.

generator_version.description: The version of scripts/generate-method-env-images.py that emitted the file.

source_revision.description: The methods repository commit (12 hex) the entries were generated from. One revision, one manifest.

base_contract.description: The container-contract version the benchmark base images are built under (index.json contract_versions).

envs.description: One entry per runnable method (index.json runnable: true) per published arch, sorted by env_id.

arch.description: The architecture the layer was built and published for (D09: amd64 only for now).

oci_ref.description: The artifact repository ref, without tag or digest (the tag/digest are separate fields).

digest.description: The OCI content digest of the artifact manifest. The runtime fetches oci_ref@digest.

layer_sha256.description: sha256 of the published layer.squashfs bytes; verified offline before mount.

size_bytes.description: The layer.squashfs byte length; shown by the download rows before the download starts.

base_ref.description: The benchmark base image the delta was computed against (the method Dockerfile's FROM base).

base_digest.description: The digest of that benchmark base image; the pairing anchor (com.txr.trimmed-from-digest).

wrapper_code_sha256.description: sha256 of the byte concatenation of /code/method.json then the wrapper file (/code/run.R or /code/run.py).

layer_schema.description: LAYER_SCHEMA_VERSION, mirrored from the /.txr-method-env-layer-schema marker inside the squashfs (DEC-11).
